$comment: Starling mode-routing decision output contract, v1 (E18/E19/E26).
One decision record per take: which typed versioned mode the raw
recognition attempt routed to, why (source), what leading prefix was
removed, and the payload view the authoring stage consumes.
Raw preservation: the routed payload is a VIEW, never a mutation. The
raw attempt (raw_attempt_id) keeps the complete recognition text and
audio; payload_view records raw_preserved=true, the view text and the
removed_prefix_span. v1 spans are Unicode code-point offsets starting
at 0 (span_encoding const), explicitly not native UTF-16 ranges, and
reconstruct as raw == raw[:span[0]] + view_text + raw[span[1]:] with
span[0] == 0, i.e. view_text == raw[span[1]:].
Permission boundary (frozen): this document is INCAPABLE of expressing
a provider, route, grant or permission change. A leading phrase
recognized after audio capture cannot retroactively protect uploaded
audio or authorize additional context/providers; the ASR route and
consent freeze at activation (see context-snapshot.schema.json and the
runtime protocol's mode.routeFrozen, which precedes any audio leaving
the runtime). tests/test_mode_routing.py asserts structurally that no
field name in this schema can carry such a change and that
additionalProperties is false everywhere, so the vocabulary of this
record is exactly the whitelisted set below.
Conflicts: ambiguous equal-rank rule or phrase matches produce
status needs_resolution with a conflicts entry listing the tied
candidates (mode_id plus the rule id or alias phrase it came via).
Conflicts are surfaced for user resolution; they are never resolved by
a guess. mode_id/mode_version are null exactly when no mode was chosen
(blocked or needs_resolution).
explanation is the human-visible route reason for overlay/history. It
names modes, rules and configured aliases only; it must not persist
sensitive selection contents in ordinary logs.
source enum: manual (locked or unlocked explicit choice), phrase
(registered leading alias), escape (leading literal), project_rule /
site_rule / app_rule (frozen scoped rule, by specificity), default,
policy (secure-field block), conflict (needs_resolution).
Keyword subset: only keywords the repo's minischema.py fallback
understands are used, so jsonschema and minischema agree. The exact
2-element span shape is enforced by the executable oracle
tests/mode_routing.py (minischema cannot express maxItems).
